name: cappy
description: Local budget-paced LLM proxy for any provider — spread a prepaid API budget across the month, for OpenAI-compatible providers today (DeepSeek, OpenAI, Groq, and more), with pricing kept fresh via models.dev

scripts.build: tsc && mkdir -p dist/adapters/pricing && cp src/adapters/pricing/*.json dist/adapters/pricing/ && rm -rf dist/dashboard/public && cp -r src/dashboard/public dist/dashboard/public && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const c=fs.readFileSync('dist/cli.js','utf8'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/cli.js','#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+c); fs.chmodSync('dist/cli.js',0o755)"
